basis: Budget aftermarket fitted-set estimate, not a retailer quote. A$1,000 allows local price variation; some TyrePoint SUV freight can add A$20/tyre. No Brisbane four-tyre stock or final quote confirmed. The previous A$2,036 Hankook acoustic/EV premium set is not compulsory. Australian original Model Y guidance permits replacement tyres meeting or exceeding original load/speed specifications; confirm the actual original/Juniper placard and XL construction. Life is a common 40,000 km planning assumption (25,000–60,000 km sensitivity), not a measured model or tyre average. Wear varies with tyre choice, driving, maintenance and vehicle; model-specific replacement averages were not verified. Annual allowance = set budget × annual km ÷ 40,000, rounded to A$10. Age/damage can require earlier replacement. Alignment is additional; actual placard, wheel package and local fitted quote must be checked. Matching size/load/speed does not establish equal braking, efficiency or durability.
